title: Config key renamed in loader; main still reads the old key and silently defaults

pr_metadata.title: Rename DB_URL to DATABASE_URL
pr_metadata.body: Platform sets DATABASE_URL; align the key.

labels.defect: Environment key renamed in the loader while main.go still reads the literal old key
labels.evidence: Deployments that set DATABASE_URL take the dbURL() path only when DB_URL is empty; environments still exporting DB_URL connect to the legacy target with no warning.

labels.defect: Hard-coded old key bypasses the renamed constant
labels.evidence: os.Getenv("DB_URL") should use DBURLKey; the duplicated literal is what makes the rename half-applied.
